home.history_desc: Kabul Art Gallery is a company that offers paintings of batik in Yogyakarta. The majority of its customers are foreigners from a number of different countries including Germany. Foreign tourists would most likely prefer to buy batik in the form of paintings.

profil.history_desc: Kabul Art Gallery is a company that offers paintings of batik in Yogyakarta. The majority of its customers are foreigners from a number of different countries including Germany. Foreign tourists would most likely prefer to buy batik in the form of paintings.
profil.bio_p1: WH. Kabul was born on January 25, 1950 in Yogyakarta. He creates classic, modern, and traditional batik paintings with a distinctive signature style combining natural and modern pigments.
profil.bio_p2: WH. Kabul lahir pada 25 Januari 1950 di Yogyakarta. Beliau telah menghasilkan karya seni batik lukis bercorak klasik, modern, dan tradisional dengan karakteristik unik tersendiri melalui perpaduan pewarna alami dan sintetis berkualitas tinggi.
